records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Wei,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Blue Works!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero engagement: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets. Two Wrenfield outreach emails ([email:0d28f9bc], [email:2a38dcce]) drew no customer reply, so no signal of intent. 8 days left, but silent, fully unstarted Starter accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a week. If it's still sitting untouched, the easiest starting point is one real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the rest of Blue Works in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Priya
